matvec-a.description: One public BitMatrix::matvec returning a fresh BitVec, with route selection, the per-row bundle call, the parity fold, the output allocation and every output append inside the measured call

matvec-lane-parity.description: One public BitMatrix::matvec_parity_kernel in the same build as the public route, with the per-row call to the bundle's and_parity_fn, the output allocation and every output append inside the measured call
